title: p5.js reference
summary: The p5.js commands and JavaScript from the course, each with what it does. Copy a card into your sketch.

items.label: createCanvas
items.hint: Makes the drawing area: width, then height, in pixels. Put it first in setup(). (0, 0) is the top left and y counts down.

items.label: background
items.hint: Fills the whole canvas with a colour. One number is grey (0 black, 255 white); three are red, green, blue.

items.label: circle
items.hint: Draws a circle: x and y of its middle, then its width.

items.label: rect
items.hint: Draws a rectangle: x and y of its top-left corner, then width and height.

items.label: ellipse
items.hint: Draws an oval: x and y of its middle, then its width and height.

items.label: line
items.hint: Draws a line from one point to another: x1, y1, x2, y2.

items.label: triangle
items.hint: Draws a triangle from its three corners: x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3.

items.label: text
items.hint: Writes words on the canvas at x, y. Join a number on with +: "Score: " + score.

items.label: fill
items.hint: Sets the colour of shapes drawn after it (red, green, blue, each 0 to 255). It does not change shapes already drawn.

items.label: stroke
items.hint: Sets the colour of outlines drawn after it.

items.label: noStroke
items.hint: Draws shapes with no outline.

items.label: strokeWeight
items.hint: Sets how thick outlines and lines are.

items.label: setup
items.hint: Runs once, when the sketch starts. Make the canvas and set things up here.

items.label: draw
items.hint: Runs again and again, about 60 times a second. Clear the canvas, then draw things where they are now.

items.label: let
items.hint: Makes a variable. Put it above setup() to keep its value between frames.

items.label: change a variable
items.hint: Moves the value on a little: x goes up by 2 each time this runs.

items.label: frameCount
items.hint: How many frames have been drawn so far. It goes up by 1 every frame.

items.label: mouseX and mouseY
items.hint: Where the mouse is on the canvas, updated every frame.

items.label: if
items.hint: Does the code in the braces only when the condition is true. Compare with <, >, ===.

items.label: if else
items.hint: Chooses between two things.

items.label: and, or
items.hint: && means both must be true; || means either one.

items.label: array
items.hint: Makes a list. The first item is heights[0], because counting starts at 0.

items.label: array item
items.hint: One item of a list, by its place.

items.label: length
items.hint: How many items are in a list.

items.label: push
items.hint: Adds an item to the end of a list.

items.label: for count
items.hint: Repeats the code in the braces, with i counting 0, 1, 2, ... up to one less than 6.

items.label: for of
items.hint: Does the code once for each item of a list, with star as that item.

items.label: random
items.hint: A random number from the first number up to (not including) the second.

items.label: object
items.hint: Keeps the values of one thing together, each with a name.

items.label: property
items.hint: Reads one value of an object with a dot. Change it the same way: star.y = star.y + 1;

items.label: function
items.hint: Gives code a name. The names in the brackets are parameters. It runs only when called: drawFlower(80, 100);

items.label: return
items.hint: Hands an answer back to the line that called the function.

items.label: mousePressed
items.hint: p5 runs this each time the mouse is clicked. You never call it yourself.

items.label: keyPressed
items.hint: p5 runs this each time a key is pressed; key holds which one.

items.label: dist
items.hint: The straight distance between two points. Two things touch when it is small.

items.label: sin and cos
items.hint: cos gives how far across and sin how far up or down for a point going round a circle (angle in radians; radians(30) converts degrees).

items.label: map
items.hint: Turns a number in one range into the matching number in another.
